characters.name: Zeke
characters.intro: A seven-foot wall of a man with a big shield and a softer heart, who just wants to get everyone home. Brutus the scrappy dog is never far behind.

attacks.name: Unstoppable
attacks.description: Zeke roars and digs in. He can't be held down, restrained or made vulnerable, and heavy hits land a tier lighter.
attacks.animation_idea: a gold shockwave ring pulses out from his base and a brief shield glyph locks over the piece.

attacks.name: Shield Charge
attacks.description: he hurdles in shield first and slams it into the enemy's chest, knocking them back. He also punches with the shield edge to knock biters off allies.
attacks.animation_idea: the piece lurches forward and a dust-and-impact burst flashes at the shield face.

attacks.name: I Am Your Shield
attacks.description: Zeke throws himself in front of an attack meant for a friend and takes the hit instead.
attacks.animation_idea: a translucent shield arc snaps between Zeke and an ally token, and the incoming strike sparks off it.

characters.name: Thessaly
characters.intro: A small, four-winged Valkyrie with glowing arcane tattoos and no memory of her past. Sweet, sharp and very, very dangerous when someone she loves gets hurt.

attacks.name: Unleash Chaos
attacks.description: raw arcana pours out of her tattoos, binds the target and squeezes like wire. She often pushes it harder with Manipulate Magic to hit a second target.
attacks.animation_idea: crimson tattoo lines flare, then red energy threads whip out and cinch around the target.

attacks.name: Chained Kunai and Chokehold
attacks.description: her kunai appear on the shackles at her wrists. She throws them, or loops the chain around a foe's neck as a garrote.
attacks.animation_idea: a glowing red kunai streak with a chain trail that loops and tightens.

attacks.name: Feather Blades
attacks.description: she hardens her own feathers into knives and flings them off her wings.
attacks.animation_idea: the wings flare and three feather-blade streaks fan out, tipped with pink.

characters.name: Prim
characters.intro: The Crimson Crescent's star performer: purple, veiled, and always singing, even mid-fight. The party's people person, who makes sure the crowd, and the enemy, are watching her.

attacks.name: Finishing Blast
attacks.description: a spell she casts again and again that hits only enemies and shoves them back. In ep38 it hit for 25 and landed the killing blow.
attacks.animation_idea: a purple burst ring rolls out from Prim and knocks back only the enemy tokens.

attacks.name: Invisibility Ambush
attacks.description: she turns herself invisible before a fight. She can act several times before she reappears, and enemies can't target her.
attacks.animation_idea: the piece shimmers and fades to a faint purple outline, then pops back with a sparkle.

attacks.name: Rally and Relaxing Song
attacks.description: she rallies the whole party with a die each, and sings a song that heals her allies.
attacks.animation_idea: music notes spiral up from Prim and drop little glowing dice onto ally tokens.

characters.name: Naaz
characters.intro: An archivist from a line of war mages who writes everything down. Naaz has a great staff, a little fire elemental named Nana, and big plans for a better city.

attacks.name: Power Push
attacks.description: Naaz takes the momentum of something nearby, such as a falling rock, and slams it into an enemy, blasting them back to far range.
attacks.animation_idea: a pale force ripple bends the air, then the target token jolts back with a rock-dust trail.

attacks.name: Ice Spike
attacks.description: Naaz plants a foot, frost runs along the ground and a spike of ice bursts up through the target.
attacks.animation_idea: a frost line crawls from the base and a jagged ice spike shoots up under the enemy.

attacks.name: Not This Time
attacks.description: Naaz forces an enemy to reroll an attack that was about to land on a friend.
attacks.animation_idea: the incoming strike freezes, rewinds with a clock-hand glyph and fizzles.

characters.name: Saveas
characters.intro: The arena's champion: a tall faun with one broken horn, a red-gemmed longsword and his own merch. Always attacking, never defending, and the crowd loves him for it.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.description: a spinning longsword cleave that cuts through everything around him. In ep28 he steadied the spin with Mellanee's axe.
attacks.animation_idea: a circular orange-and-navy slash arc sweeps fully around the piece.

attacks.name: Faun Kick
attacks.description: he kicks off a target, punting the enemy away or launching himself clear.
attacks.animation_idea: a hoof-shaped impact flash with a short dust streak flying off the enemy.

attacks.name: No Mercy
attacks.description: he spends 3 Hope to get +1 to attack rolls until his next rest.
attacks.animation_idea: the sword's red hilt gem flares and a red aura hangs on the blade.

characters.name: Drex
characters.intro: A three-foot mushroom man from the mainland who slips through shadows and reads the memories of the dead. Polite, odd, and much deadlier than he looks.

attacks.name: Reign of Blades
attacks.description: Drex spins and daggers fly out to hit every enemy around him. The wounds show up on their shadows first.
attacks.animation_idea: a ring of dark dagger streaks bursts outward, with cut marks flickering on the shadows below.

attacks.name: Shadow Sneak Attack
attacks.description: he hides in darkness, strikes from cloak with his floating blade shards and then shadow-steps in place to hide again. In ep38 one crit hit for 55.
attacks.animation_idea: the piece dims to a silhouette, then a star-shaped cluster of tiny blade cuts flashes on the target.

attacks.name: Veil of Night
attacks.description: a curtain of darkness that enemies can't see through, though Drex can.
attacks.animation_idea: a black frosted-glass wall rises in front of Drex, and his eyes glint through it.

characters.name: Mellanee
characters.intro: A big, scruffy Katari scout from Diego's crew who joined the party at Murphy Farm. She grins a lot, carries a greataxe, and would rather use her fists.

attacks.name: Combo Strike
attacks.description: she marks a stress and chains hits, rolling her combo die again and again for extra damage. She usually leaps into the air as she combos.
attacks.animation_idea: a quick chain of three or four impact pops, each bigger than the last.

attacks.name: Bare-Knuckle Punch
attacks.description: Mellanee drops her axe and fights with her fists, and hits land like breaking bones.
attacks.animation_idea: a fist-shaped shock flash with a cartoon crack burst.

attacks.name: Arcane-Charged Punch
attacks.description: Thessaly pours her magic into Mel's fists, and Mel throws all her weight into one punch that shatters a magic barrier.
attacks.animation_idea: a red-glowing fist punches through, and a glass-crack pattern spreads out and shatters.

characters.name: Kerropi
characters.intro: A hooded, chain-smoking former scout who led the party from the front and can become almost anything with fur, fangs or a frog tongue.

attacks.name: Pack Predator Beastform
attacks.description: she shifts into a wolf or hyena and adds bonus damage to her bite when an ally has just hit the same enemy.
attacks.animation_idea: a wolf-head silhouette lunges over the piece with a claw-slash mark.

attacks.name: Water Elemental Surge
attacks.description: she channels water into her beast form, and when she deals damage, every other enemy close by marks stress.
attacks.animation_idea: a water swirl spins around her base and splashes out onto the nearby enemies.

attacks.name: Fire Incarnation
attacks.description: she lights herself up in a slow, controlled burn and holds her ground. She can also breathe a thin line of fire, even in beast form.
attacks.animation_idea: an ember aura flickers around the piece and a thin flame jet streaks forward.
